records.reason: DataFusion 55 exposes provider and physical cardinality through TableProvider::statistics and StatisticsContext, but its EXPLAIN formats do not render estimated cardinality; the focused cardinality test asserts Exact(10000) through both native APIs.
DataFusion 55 does not support DuckDB's EXPLAIN JSON format or render estimated cardinality in its other EXPLAIN formats; this is an engine presentation boundary, not a VGI protocol adaptation.
